verdict.rationale: The only recurring-automation evidence is a single line, "Get notified whenever relevant papers are published," which implies an ongoing monitoring or alert job on new literature. Nothing shows users can define schedules, cron-like triggers, or recurring workflows; the API and MCP entries describe on-demand queries only. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling (cadence/triggers), recurring execution of arbitrary research workflows, documentation of alert configuration, and independent corroboration.
